depiction.primary_object: rounded square frame with three horizontal text lines
modifiers: counter-clockwise circular arrow in bottom-right corner
depiction.composition: single bordered note or list icon with bottom-right circular arrow badge

readings.meaning: restore document / recover note or backup

ambiguity: Can be confused with a generic document refresh/reload icon or a general file backup icon.

modifier_semantics.meaning: history, revert, restore, undo, or previous versions

task_intents: restore deleted or overwritten document version
write release notes and changelog entries
revert configuration file to previous state
review edit history on shared doc
reset recurring packing or cleaning checklist
recover lost notes from cloud backup
audit document revision log for compliance

reasoning: The icon combines a text/list box with a counter-clockwise history/revert arrow, clearly signifying version history, changelogs, or restoring a previous draft of a document. It fits tasks in software, writing, and admin work involving revision logs or file recovery, though it is somewhat specialized compared to a plain document icon.
